description: This file defines the HonoUser interface, representing a user within the Hono authentication system. It extends the Principal interface and provides method signatures to retrieve user authorities, JWT token, expiration status, and expiration time.

classes.name: HonoUser
classes.description: An interface that models a user of the Hono service API, encapsulating user authorities, token, expiration check, and expiration time.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Returns the authorities granted to the user.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns a JSON Web Token representing the user's claims.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Determines if the user's claims have expired, indicating whether authorities should be considered invalid.

methods.name: getExpirationTime
methods.description: Returns the point in time after which the user's authorities are invalid.
